features.justification_quote: If TTI is 8, the platform must hard-stop at 10.

features.quote: Platform must detect A->B->A and pause, requiring human-in-the-loop
features.justification_quote: Platform must detect A->B->A and pause, requiring human-in-the-loop or automatic context compression.

features.quote: Platform must flag runs where token consumption exceeds 2x the expected baseline
features.justification_quote: Platform must flag runs where token consumption exceeds 2x the expected baseline for a task complexity.

features.quote: the model is authorized to reject linter/test feedback if it detects a paradox
features.justification_quote: they will attempt to fix impossible, contradictory errors rather than pushing back.

features.quote: Implement aggressive sliding-window memory summarization in the orchestrator, discarding previous failed diffs.
features.justification_quote: In a loop, the context fills with historical mistakes.

features.quote: Implement state-diff oscillation detection at the orchestrator level.
features.justification_quote: Do not rely on the LLM to break itself out of a loop.

features.quote: If a specific code block has been edited 3 times without passing tests, freeze it from further edits
features.justification_quote: freeze it from further edits and force the model to write a new file or explain the impossibility.

features.quote: Hard caps on per-task token generation are mandatory.
features.justification_quote: A model in a self-criticism loop is a denial-of-wallet attack vector.
